criteria.integrity: Readable finite audio, unchanged frames/sample rate/channels, no newly saturated samples; reliable detected lag/drift must be within one sample.
criteria.limits: Onset and discontinuity measures are frozen engineering heuristics, not recognised professional-quality standards. Correlated sources may make bleed attribution non-identifiable.
criteria.professional_acceptance: Requires separately recorded explicit human approval of the exact model, pipeline, options and audio hashes.

limits: Exact-reference diagnostic controls only. No separator ran. These are procedural surrogates, not recordings or model quality evidence.
